about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, a well-established Maltese company specialising in the supply and installation of products for residential, commercial and hospitality projects, for a detail-oriented and organised Accounts Clerk to join their team in Luqa, Malta.

The Accounts Clerk supports the day-to-day accounting operations of the business. You will post accounting entries, issue sales invoices and receipts, monitor outgoing payments, cheque payments and bank deposits, carry out regular bank reconciliations and manage petty cash, while following up with customers on overdue invoices and keeping accounting records and filing in good order.

This full-time, on-site position pays €1,500–€1,600 per month and suits someone with at least 2 years of local accounting and bookkeeping experience, good knowledge of Maltese VAT regulations and confidence with accounting software such as Sage or Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. It is a good opportunity to develop your career within a well-established Maltese company.
